metadata.title: FullHunt Custom Connector
metadata.description: Logic Apps custom connector for the FullHunt API: host, domain, intel, Nexus and vulnerability intelligence lookups. Deploy it before the FullHunt playbooks.
prerequisites: A FullHunt API key. Lookups consume FullHunt credits (1 per call).

metadata.description: Name of the FullHunt custom connector

properties.description: FullHunt attack surface intelligence: host, domain, intel, Nexus and vulnerability intelligence lookups.

info.title: FullHunt
info.description: FullHunt attack surface intelligence: host, domain, intel, Nexus and vulnerability intelligence lookups.

get.description: Returns the API key's account status and remaining credits. Does not consume credits.
Returns FullHunt's attack surface record for a host name (not an IP address). 1 credit.
Returns metadata, WHOIS data and full host records for an apex domain. 1 credit. Responses can be large for big domains.

parameters.name: resolvable_only
parameters.description: Set to 0 to include unresolvable hosts

get.description: Returns metadata, WHOIS data and subdomain names for an apex domain. 1 credit.
Hosts that resolve to an IPv4 address. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts in an IPv4 range. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.

parameters.name: ip_start
parameters.description: First IPv4 address of the range

parameters.name: ip_end
parameters.description: Last IPv4 address of the range

get.description: Hosts announced by an autonomous system. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Virtual hosts in an autonomous system. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts under an apex domain. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Intel record for a host name. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts running a product. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts with a FullHunt tag. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts using a web technology. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts using an MX server. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Hosts using a name server. Requires the Data Intelligence module. 1 credit.
Network, geolocation, cloud and CDN context for an IPv4 address or host name. 1 credit.
Checks whether an IP is a known Tor exit node. Always returns HTTP 200; check the body status (200 found, 404 not found). 1 credit.
Certificates observed on cloud infrastructure whose DNS names start with the query. 1 credit.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Domain or DNS name prefix (3+ characters)

get.description: Host names observed for an apex domain in passive DNS. 1 credit.
Organization and asset-collection context for an apex domain. 1 credit.
Domain collections that match a company name. 1 credit.
WHOIS record for an apex domain. 1 credit.
Domains that match WHOIS filters. Provide at least one filter. 1 credit.
CVE intelligence: CVSS, EPSS, KEV, exploit availability and advisories. Query by upper-case CVE ID, CPE or keyword. 1 credit.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: CVE ID (e.g. CVE-2021-44228), CPE, or keyword (3-100 characters)

get.description: Exploit and known-exploited records for a CVE ID or keyword. 1 credit.
Security advisories (GHSA, OSV and others) for a CVE ID, advisory ID, keyword, ecosystem or package. 1 credit.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: CVE ID, advisory ID or keyword
